title: Calendar heatmap
description: Daily values on a calendar, like contribution graphs: commits, learning streaks, workouts, orders. Each day is a cell colored by level; month and weekday names, tooltip dates and the first day of the week follow the locale. The legend hides / shows levels; the arrow keys move by day and by week, and the tooltip shows the date.

props.name: data
props.description: Daily values (several entries of the same day add up)

props.name: range
props.description: Days shown: a year (`2026`) or an inclusive `[start, end]` range

props.name: layout
props.description: `weeks`: a column per week and a row per weekday (one strip per year when the range spans several years); `months`: a small calendar per month

props.name: weekStart
props.description: First day of the week, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the month and weekday names, of the tooltip dates, of the default `weekStart` and of the built-in texts

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the highest level (lower levels are lighter)

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the levels, lowest first (replaces `color` and sets the number of levels)

props.name: levels
props.description: Number of color levels above the empty days

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Upper bounds of the levels but the last, ascending (`[2, 5, 10]`: 1-2, 3-5, 6-10, more); an even split of the largest value by default

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the cells, in pixels

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cells, in pixels

props.name: maxCellSize
props.description: Largest cell size, in pixels (cells shrink to fit the width)

props.name: monthLabels
props.description: Month names (and years) around the cells

props.name: weekdayLabels
props.description: Weekday names beside (weeks) or above (months) the cells

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is clicked (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changes

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is clicked, tapped or activated with Enter

examples.title: Contributions over a year
examples.description: Without range, the chart shows the 53 weeks ending on the last day of the data. color sets the highest level (lower levels are lighter, in light and dark themes); onClick reports the day, with its formatted date in name and its YYYY-MM-DD date in date.

examples.title: Filtering levels
examples.description: Daily electricity use with four custom colors and thresholds. hidden makes the legend controlled: onToggle returns the hiddenIndexes to store, so the buttons can hide levels too, and the readout adds up the days still shown.

examples.title: Click to log a day
examples.description: A workout log in layout="months" with a single level (levels={1}): onClick gives the date of the clicked day, which is added to or removed from the state that feeds data. The streak and the readout follow.

examples.title: Year picker and hover
examples.description: One dataset of production incidents over three years: the RadioGroup only changes range, which picks the year drawn. onHover reports the hovered day below the chart (null when the pointer leaves), with a message for the days still to come.

examples.title: Locales
examples.description: locale translates the month and weekday names and the tooltip dates, and gives the first day of the week (Sunday in the United States and Japan, Monday in France and Germany, Saturday in Egypt). maxCellSize keeps the cells small on wide screens.

examples.title: Month calendars
examples.description: layout="months" draws a small calendar per month, in the grid that gives the biggest cells. weekStart overrides the first day of the week given by the locale; days without orders (closed on Mondays) stay empty.

examples.title: Several years
examples.description: A range longer than a year is drawn as one strip per year, with the year beside it; the height grows with the number of strips.

examples.title: Custom tooltip
examples.description: Six months of sleep in a [start, end] range. renderTooltip receives the formatted date in name and the hours in value, and compares them with the eight-hour goal; nights without data get their own message.

examples.title: Learning streak
examples.description: range={2026} shows the whole year, future days included. thresholds sets the bounds of the levels (1–15, 16–30, 31–60 and more than 60 minutes) and format their names; the streaks are computed from the same data.

CalendarHeatmapProps.data: Daily values: a date (YYYY-MM-DD string, Date or timestamp) and a value; values of the same day add up
CalendarHeatmapProps.range: Days shown: a year (2026) or an inclusive [start, end] range; the 53 weeks ending on the last day of the data by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.layout: weeks: a column per week and a row per weekday (a strip per year for long ranges); months: a small calendar per month
CalendarHeatmapProps.weekStart: First day of the week, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; taken from locale by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.locale: BCP 47 locale of the month and weekday names, of the tooltip dates, of the default weekStart and of the built-in texts; defaults to the page language (`<html lang>`)
CalendarHeatmapProps.color: Color of the highest level (lower levels are lighter); the first palette color by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.colors: Colors of the levels, lowest first (replaces color and sets the number of levels)
CalendarHeatmapProps.levels: Number of color levels above the empty days
CalendarHeatmapProps.thresholds: Upper bounds of the levels but the last, ascending ([2, 5, 10]: 1–2, 3–5, 6–10, more); an even split of the largest value by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.gap: Gap between the cells, in pixels
CalendarHeatmapProps.radius: Corner radius of the cells, in pixels
CalendarHeatmapProps.maxCellSize: Largest cell size, in pixels (cells shrink to fit the width)
CalendarHeatmapProps.monthLabels: Shows the month names (and the years)
CalendarHeatmapProps.weekdayLabels: Shows the weekday names beside (weeks) or above (months) the cells

CalendarDatum.date: Day of the value: a YYYY-MM-DD string, a Date or a timestamp (local calendar day)
CalendarDatum.value: Value of the day (negative values count as 0)

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
